_readme: Manually curated facts. The updater never edits this file and never classifies a closed PR as integrated on its own. 'class' values: squashed (closed, maintainer squashed it onto main, commit verified), consolidated (closed, author-credited commits verified as ancestors of upstream main via a replacement/consolidation PR), retained (closed, kept in a replacement PR, no proof of integration). Merged/open/draft come from GitHub live.

upstream_main_checks.willfaust/Madeira: Blobless clone of willfaust/Madeira; `git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> main` and `git log main --author=Jelly-RayTian`.
